top3.headline: AI has not paid off yet outside the biggest tech firms
top3.whyItMatters: Slok says the AI story will be decided in the S&P 493, so measure returns, not usage.

top3.headline: Open-weight models now carry 72% of OpenRouter's tokens
top3.whyItMatters: Demand rose 27x since last November, so test open models before committing to one vendor's prices.

top3.headline: Pennsylvania makes AI labels mandatory on ads shown in the state
top3.whyItMatters: The rule covers ads made anywhere, so national campaigns need a disclosure plan.

items.title: OpenRouter token demand is up 27x, and open models carry 72%
items.takeaway: Per a16z, weekly tokens rose from about 6T to 165T since last November; open-weight share rose from 28% to 72%.
items.soWhat: Open-weight models now carry most of this traffic, so price them against closed models in your plans.

items.title: Dalio: idea meritocracies are harder to run but decide better
items.takeaway: Encouraging disagreement is harder than top-down control, but believable people learning from each other evolve faster.
items.soWhat: Building a team that argues well takes effort, and Dalio says it pays back in better decisions.

items.title: Lyn Alden sees 'fiscal dominance' move from niche to normal
items.takeaway: Alden quotes Eric Fine: G-10 peers who once called it unlikely now use the term themselves.
items.soWhat: Fine calls this the beginning of the end of denial, so watch how sovereigns talk about debt.

items.title: Vercel's CEO says managing AI well is the top hiring skill
items.takeaway: Rauch looks for people who know when they over-guide AI and when they under-guide it.
items.soWhat: Hiring is starting to test judgment with AI, so ask candidates how they steer it.

items.title: Pennsylvania now requires labels on AI-generated ads
items.takeaway: The act covers image, video, audio and text ads airing in the state; 'significantly modified' is not defined.
items.soWhat: Ads running in Pennsylvania need AI labels wherever they were made, so check your campaigns.

items.title: Anthropic lists which staff to tag for Claude product feedback
items.takeaway: Alex Albert names contacts for Claude Code, Chat/Cowork, Duet, Tag, API/Platform and community.
items.soWhat: Teams building on Claude now have named people to route bugs and requests to directly.

items.title: Apollo finds no AI payoff yet outside the tech giants
items.takeaway: Slok: revenue per worker and margins rise for the Mag 7 but stay flat for the S&P 493.
items.soWhat: Outside tech, token spend is being treated as a cost, so tie each AI budget to measurable returns.
